speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang
text: asked the Minister for Manpower whether the requirement for reporting work-related or workplace accidents can also include cases where an employee who meets with an accident is placed on light duty by the doctor for more than three days, whether consecutive or not.

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
text: Can I just confirm that we are having a list of specified injuring similar to what the UK has, which is that regardless of the number of medical certificates (MCs) or number of days of light duty, mandatory reporting is required?

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
text: The second clarification is whether we can follow what we do for occupational diseases where it is the doctor that reports the occupational diseases rather than the employers, that is, whether the doctors will in the future do reporting for work-related accidents rather than the employers?

speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
text: The second question was with regard to the practice with doctors.
